plugin.name: edge-flipping
plugin._long: Flip workspaces by moving cursor to screen edges. Uses approach velocity detection to prevent accidental flips during careful edge work. Supports diagonal corner flips and optional repeat-on-hold for traversing multiple workspaces.

option.name: edge_px
option._long: Distance from screen edge that triggers a flip. Smaller values require more precise edge targeting.

option.name: approach_zone_px
option._long: Outer zone for velocity detection. Cursor must traverse from outside this zone to the edge zone within max_approach_ms to trigger a flip. Set equal to edge_px to disable velocity detection.

option.name: max_approach_ms
option._long: Maximum time allowed to traverse from approach zone entry to edge. If exceeded, flip is disarmed until cursor leaves the approach zone entirely. Prevents accidental flips from slow cursor movement near edges.

option.name: check_interval_ms
option._long: Motion event throttle interval in milliseconds. Set to 0 (default) to auto-compute as max_approach_ms/10, ensuring enough samples to measure approach velocity accurately. Set to a positive value to override explicitly.

option.name: enable_pointer_flip
option._long: Allow flipping by moving cursor to edge (no window drag required).

option.name: enable_move_flip
option._long: Allow flipping while dragging a window to screen edge.

option.name: wrap
option._long: Wrap from last workspace to first (and vice versa).

option.name: require_modifier
option._long: Only flip when specified modifier key(s) are held.
